scope: camera-facing apartment facade coating, aluminum sash interfaces, clear float-glass panes, and non-emissive interior backing
renderingConstraint: Unity 6000.3.0f1 built-in Standard shader fallback; authored replacement art may supersede generated fallback
visualTarget: 4K live-action-film plausibility with angular response produced by lighting/PBR rather than painted highlights
researchStatus: Period-plausible generated fallback. Exact housing-complex glazing specification, coating manufacturer, and curtain/interior layout remain pending field/photo or drawing verification.

materials.construction: reinforced-concrete substrate with cementitious leveling/render and aged exterior protective coating
materials.finish: matte mineral-looking coating with low-frequency application/aging variation and sub-millimetric-to-millimetric aggregate relief

angularResponse.front: broad diffuse return, weak dielectric highlight, no polished-stone sparkle
angularResponse.oblique: coating relief and local roughness breakup become readable without a uniform sheen
angularResponse.grazing: subtle Fresnel lift only; shallow relief catches light without a mirror stripe

materials.geometryVsMaterial: window returns, slab lips, drip edges, penetrations, construction joints and facade offsets are geometry; coating grain, aggregate, chalking and micro-roughness are material response
forbidden: shadow or highlight baked into albedo
facade-wide random dark stains without a runoff/contact cause
single-scale texture repetition visible in 4K crop

materials.construction: clear soda-lime float-glass fallback installed in aluminum sliding sash; nominal generated pane thickness concept 4 mm
materials.finish: clear dielectric glazing with mild age/dust/water-spot roughness; no tint painted as a dark opaque rectangle

angularResponse.front: high transmission with restrained sky/environment reflection; interior layer remains visible
angularResponse.oblique: reflection gains strength while transmitted interior darkens comparatively
angularResponse.grazing: strong dielectric Fresnel reflection while the material remains non-metallic

agingCauses: water spotting on rain-exposed exterior surface
dust accumulation near lower sash/track interface
cleaner hand-contact zones only where physically reachable
forbidden: Fade transparency that removes reflections together with alpha

materials.construction: non-emissive interior darkness/curtain backing positioned physically behind glazing only to provide transmitted depth cues in the generated fallback
materials.finish: very rough dielectric cloth/interior surfaces with low saturation and deterministic bay-to-bay variation
forbidden: pure black void across every bay
identical backing color in every apartment

assembly.mounting: glass captured in separate aluminum sash leaves; glazing plane sits behind outer frame face; interior backing is not coplanar with glass
assembly.interfaces: aluminum frame, EPDM track/seal, sill/drip edge and backing depth must remain spatially distinct
assembly.lodPolicy: transparent panes remain only where their projected size supports stable reflection; no abrupt near-camera replacement or visible LOD pop is allowed

lookdevBrief.front: One apartment bay in midsummer daylight. Read wall coating, anodized frame, two sliding clear panes and interior backing as four different materials. Glass must transmit interior tone and still retain a modest sky reflection.
lookdevBrief.oblique: 35-degree view emphasizing pane depth offset, frame extrusion, sill projection and wall return. No coplanar z-fighting or opaque glass slab.
lookdevBrief.grazing: Low-angle view along the facade so glass reflection strengthens from Fresnel while concrete stays matte and aluminum remains a broader aged metallic lobe.
lookdevBrief.crop100Percent: Inspect coating repetition, window edge aliasing, transparent sorting, duplicate reflections, light leaks, z-fighting, and whether any disabled opaque Window_* renderer remains visible.

automaticFailConditions: base opaque Window_* or StairWindow_* renderer remains visible behind replacement glazing
glass uses Fade instead of premultiplied Transparent mode
facade material metallic value is nonzero
window pane is coplanar with backing or sibling sliding pane
